changed: The invariant of fleet-zone-loss-retains-every-volume-and-each-returning-owner-fences-before-its-first-admission, whose store-history clause now allows a volume-record commit of zone 1 that ends a non-role host's attach (decision L413); the invariants of fleet-host-loss-takes-each-lost-shard-over-on-its-named-standby-with-one-owner-per-tenure, fleet-host-driver-keeps-no-epoch-reuse-one-exit-named-standby-and-the-health-rule and fleet-zone-repair-and-host-scenarios-pass-on-their-second-root, whose limits name the checks that moved to the search-nightly row fleet-scheduled-roots and, for the first two, the search-nightly records that credit them; and two new records, fleet-restart-host-loss-and-replay-checks-pass-on-their-scheduled-roots and fleet-declared-holds-leave-the-self-suspicion-count-and-brake-nominations-at-three.

property_action.reason: Its invariant states the new contract: while zone 1 is down the store history holds no commit of a shard record or replacement receipt of zone 1 and no volume-record commit of zone 1 other than the end of a non-role host's attach, which FP-LOOP-10 permits because it holds new attaches only. The record states that no scenario on this tree ends such an attach inside the outage and that the rule DOWN_ZONE_WRITE still fails every volume-record commit, so the zone-loss case on root 1 passes under the narrower and the wider clause alike; the other changed invariants move checks between tiers and keep their assertions.
